description: Careerbot helps Japanese new-graduate job seekers move from initial career guidance to self-analysis, application writing, company research, motivation statements, and interview practice. It guides students with structured questions and next-step options, while avoiding unsupported assumptions about their experiences, achievements, or numbers.

defaultPrompt: 就活を何から始めればいいかわかりません。
自分の経験からガクチカと自己PRを整理したいです。
志望企業の企業研究をして、志望動機と面接対策まで進めたいです。
